newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW-Analyst views Sweden inflation report.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Analyst views Sweden inflation report.

text.p: Following are the views of some analysts about the quarterly inflation report released by Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Thursday which lowered forecasts for inflation.
"A neutral report. It was rather expected that the report would come out with these assumptions.
"There will be no (interest rate) cuts in the near term. What sticks out is that the bank has lowered its forecasts for inflation."
